plan.title: USD and INR Bid Currency Conversion

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen described by the case.
Enable eRFX functionality required for event creation.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and keep Publish available.
Set the event type to RFQ and use the single-vendor lot-award mode.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding the product.
Add the specified product and quantity; the product's configured variant should populate as Variant 1.
Set the requested delivery location in the pricing sheet.
Invite two QA vendors corresponding to Vendor A and Vendor B without inventing company names.
Publish the RFQ after its creation prerequisites are complete.
Confirm that the event reached a published project page.
Submit a numeric bid for the first invited QA vendor; the catalog cannot select or label its currency.
Confirm that the vendor bid was accepted by the vendor portal.
Verify that the buyer sees the direct vendor response on the RFQ.
Open the buyer's comparison grid, the closest available observation point for the expected converted comparison.
Assert that the comparison grid contains the responding vendor with a real company name.
